message.content:
A vertical editorial illustration on a beige background features a red building shaped like the letters "BPJS." The structure is two stories high with an open roof, revealing an interior populated by people in various roles. Figures in white coats, blue scrubs, and casual attire occupy small, maze-like rooms filled with green plants, medical beds, and desks. One room contains oversized banknotes. 

On the rooftop, figures are seen climbing and leaning over ledges. Below, an ambulance is parked near a side entrance where a person sits on the ground. A bicycle leans against the wall, and black bags sit in a green container. In the foreground, two figures stand near a security guard on a green rug. 

A red banner hangs on the building facade with the text "BPJS KESEHATAN." Large black text at the bottom reads "INVESTIGASI KANTONG BOLONG BPJS" above a block of smaller Indonesian text. Top headers include "LIKA-LIKU PENANGKAPAN NURHADI" and "BAHAYA DANA TALANGAN BUMN." A barcode and QR code are in the bottom right corner.
